judgement.reason: Homebox supports PostgreSQL and a blob storage connection string that can point to S3, so moving data off local disk is a contained settings change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The production image stores uploaded files on local disk under /data through a file:// storage connection string and keeps the SQLite database there by default, and no shown line moves this data to S3 or PostgreSQL.
